body:
## Outcome and current status

The desired agentic experience is approved, but the runtime assignment is not. Define the first useful jobs and how they use canonical permissions and commands before implementation.

Part of #817. This is a planning/coordination deliverable. No delivery milestone label is earned merely by filing it.

## Scope and entry points

docs/specs/argus-execution-board.md Agentic Cuadrao; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; docs/specs/argus-minimum-viable-ecosystem-experience.md

No runtime code, prompt changes, model calls, provider activation or business tools. This is the approval/spec gate.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Present the first read and proposed-write journeys in plain language and obtain the founder's bounded assignment.
- [ ] Define context from plan/receipt/chart chips, current space and authorized records; specify how users remove context and return to their screen.
- [ ] Define read tools, proposed draft commands, explicit confirmation, cancellation, retry, idempotency, interruption and unfinished-message recovery.
- [ ] Apply the founder-locked LangGraph + existing Mem0/pgvector + scoped on-demand context + Render Workflows stack. Temporal/Inngest require a demonstrated unmet workflow requirement and a separate decision; Braintrust is optional evaluation tooling, while full-turn evaluation remains required.
- [ ] Honor the selected server-side provider direction. Record voice inclusion and its separate implementation needs, finance-search scope, and document/model consent ownership.
- [ ] Specify full-turn evaluation, cost/latency evidence, privacy boundaries and model-instruction change gates. Record shared contract owners and no-touch areas.

- [ ] Specify the ongoing-conversation experience from PR #835, including entry from a plan/receipt/chart, unfinished drafts, removable context and return navigation. Do not assume one unbounded transcript or one globally authorized context.
- [ ] Define space transitions and permitted history/attachment/memory use and display, including member removal or grant revocation. A space change cannot retarget a job or approve a pending action.
- [ ] Define durable-job identities, status, cancellation and recovery across app closure/relaunch using the existing Render Workflows foundation. Financial confirmation remains separate from automatic preparation.
- [ ] Record the reuse/migration map for LangGraph/checkpoints and existing memory/Mem0 components. Preserve active consumers and retained state until an authorized transition; do not treat old configuration retirement as permission to delete the shared foundation.
- [ ] Define memory consent, scope, correction, forgetting/deletion and Temporary chat behavior; explicitly decide first-release memory/voice inclusion. Provider selection is not proof of a connected capability.
- [ ] Bind approvals to the action, revision, destination and space and reject stale authority at execution. Evaluate complete jobs and customer review burden through #817's outcome standard.

- [ ] Specify the on-demand retrieval contract: bounded context, source/space/revision provenance, current authorization before model dispatch, and suppression of stale, forgotten or revoked results. Canonical records supply current financial facts; vector similarity and remembered prose cannot override them.
- [ ] Record the existing Mem0 adapter behavior and successor contract. It currently configures pgvector, disables Mem0 extraction and returns canonical IDs. Preserve ownership of confirmation, memory extraction and records unless an explicit reviewed contract changes it.

## Dependencies and parallel work

Discussion and read-only architecture comparison can run with consumer wiring. Implementation waits for this contract and a bounded assignment.

Completion prerequisites: #818. Native blocked-by links record these same prerequisites. They gate completion, not useful preparation. Existing linked issues keep their own acceptance and approval boundaries.

## Verification and closure

Use the approved scope in #817. Before a completion claim, record the original/current integration SHAs, PR head, relevant API/build identity, environment and runtime mode. Retain durable evidence for happy path, interruption/recovery, authorization and relaunch where relevant. Use focused deterministic checks and the real affected journey; document non-applicable checks instead of inventing passes. Physical journeys use the shared Mac/device scheduler.

Close with the accepted document/audit and named evidence. Activation is not applicable to this issue itself.

Any implementation requires its bounded assignment and approved contracts. Preserve default-off gates until authorized. Plan rollback at the changed owner; schema changes require backup and forward-recovery or rollback evidence before hosted execution. No merge, deployment, hosted mutation or paid provider run is authorized by this issue.

## October 4 alignment

Founder-approved planning alignment adds reuse, conversation-continuity and customer-outcome acceptance. [PR #835](https://github.com/lagarcess/argus/pull/835) carries the matching canonical documentation and remains unmerged at this edit. Existing assignments, implementation gates, labels and completion evidence remain unchanged. This edit does not claim live services or authorize paid runs, hosted changes or deployment.

## Planning evidence

Reviewed 2026-10-04 CT against integration `76b6afcb4080c6e639e8c50bdabf51621d862190`, the current execution board, master plan and open issue inventory. This is repository/GitHub planning, not a new runtime acceptance result. Deployed API/web/workflow SHAs and live runtime mode are omitted because no hosted inspection was performed. Revalidate specific gaps at assignment time.
